name: Gol Ghar — JLR Kings Sanctuary (Jungle Lodges)
signature_dish: Buffet meals with Karnataka and Indian dishes
why_it_matters: The restaurant of JLR Kings Sanctuary, the Karnataka government's Jungle Lodges and Resorts property near the Veeranahosahalli (north) gate of Nagarhole. Like every JLR property, meals are served buffet-style in the central Gol Ghar — breakfast, lunch, high tea and dinner — and reviewers single out the dinner non-veg spread. With no standalone restaurants at the north gate, in-resort dining is the only real option.
insider_tip: Meals are part of the JLR safari package and tied to the safari schedule; non-resident dining needs advance arrangement. Buffet only, no a-la-carte. Cards, UPI and cash at reception.
signature_address: JLR Kings Sanctuary, Bharathavadi, near Veeranahosahalli gate, Nagarhole National Park, Mysuru District, Karnataka 571114

name: Gudara Restaurant — Jungle Inn
signature_dish: Locally sourced Indian and Continental meals
why_it_matters: Gudara, the thatched restaurant of Jungle Inn — a rustic eco-resort about half a kilometre from the Veeranahosahalli main gate of Nagarhole. The kitchen leans on fresh, locally sourced ingredients and local staff, serving Indian, Chinese and Continental dishes. One of the very few places to eat near the north gate, where there is otherwise only a tea stall outside the booking office.
insider_tip: Food reviews are mixed — homely and local-ingredient-driven for some, ordinary for others — so set expectations to rustic-resort rather than restaurant-grade. Non-resident meals need to be booked ahead. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: Jungle Inn, Veeranahosahalli, near Nagarhole National Park main gate, Mysuru District, Karnataka 571114

name: Nagarhole Safari Booking Office Tea Stall
why_it_matters: The small tea stall just outside the Nagarhole safari booking office at the Veeranahosahalli gate — the only quick-eat option right at the safari starting point. Visitor reviews note the absence of any decent eatery here, which makes the stall the practical pre- or post-safari stop.
insider_tip: There is no proper restaurant at the safari gate — carry your own breakfast or eat at your resort, and use the stall only for tea and a quick snack before the morning drive. Cash; carry small notes.
signature_address: Safari booking office tea stall, Veeranahosahalli gate, Nagarhole National Park, Mysuru District, Karnataka 571114
